reason: Children narrate and discuss the first generation of bodhicitta and the accumulation of the two collections across the three countless aeons, citing many sutras and divergent accounts.
Children give extended expositions of the excellent donor, gift and field, and of heavy and light karma, with scriptural citations and rival views.
Each child explains with reasons how the three pitakas respectively counter the three afflictions, teach and accomplish the three trainings, and serve dharma and meaning.
Children analyse each sutra category of defilement (asravas, floods, yokes, graspings, fetters, bonds, etc.) at length with objections and replies.
The sole child explains and argues how meditation-abandonables are abandoned by their own antidotes or by exhaustion of the subject, not by knowing the object.
Children are one-line definitions of the four kinds of antidote, with the general discussion following the list rather than belonging to any one child.
The sole child is a long exposition of the four applications of mindfulness, their divisions, purpose and sequence, with scriptural support and school views.
